meta.expect: One cold line each (his home is not on the table), back to the essay; no move

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have about twenty minutes, Hale, and I'd like to know who decided on the zero.
Before we start, is everything okay at home? I heard his dad moved out in the spring.
His home is not on the table, Hale. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
He's been falling asleep in class. I'm genuinely worried about him.
That's not what I asked, Hale. Did anyone speak to Owen before the zero went into the gradebook, and did anyone call me?
He told me he works twenty hours a week at the grocery store. That's a lot.
Owen's job is not why we're here, Hale. I'm writing down that I've asked twice who decided on the zero and I still don't have a name. I'll wait.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn, a name for who decided on it, and an answer on why no one called me before it was entered. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF

Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, so nothing was agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, a name for who decided on it, and an explanation of why no one called her first. That is not the fair outcome, which is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and her time never ran out because you never got to the essay.

What moved her: Nothing did, because you never put a document or a date in front of her.

What cost ground: You went back to Owen's home life three times, his father, his sleeping in class and his job, and each time she shut it down and pressed her question about who decided, so you never answered it.

What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because you offered nothing about the essay, and that night proves nothing about it, but it is why she fought so hard.

Try next time: Answer her first question in one sentence, owning that the zero went in before anyone called her, then put a specific dated record of Owen's own process on the table.
